description: This Java test file contains unit tests for the FeatureDefinitionCreated class, including tests for immutability, equality, null argument handling, JSON serialization/deserialization, and instance creation from JSON. It is a JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of FeatureDefinitionCreated.

classes.name: FeatureDefinitionCreatedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for FeatureDefinitionCreated, containing various unit tests for validation, equality, serialization, and instantiation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that instances of FeatureDefinitionCreated are immutable and that FeatureDefinition is also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating FeatureDefinitionCreated with a null ThingId string throws a ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that passing null for ThingId argument throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatureId
methods.description: Tests that passing null for feature ID raises NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that passing null for definition raises NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the toJson method returns the expected JSON representation of the instance.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating an instance of FeatureDefinitionCreated from a valid JSON string.
